PURPOSE

Establish the evidence required before claiming that StoryAtlas works for novel-scale texts, many recalls, or population analyses. This is a measured certification slice, not an optimization license.

NAMED BUDGETS

Before implementation, record representative provider fixtures and explicit budgets for compile latency, first render, interaction latency, memory, DOM/SVG mark count, page count, receipt size, evidence retention, privacy-safe display, accessibility, and output size. Keep local, hosted, and live-browser evidence distinct.

ACCEPTANCE

- Fixed, versioned fixtures cover a long narrative, repeated recalls, and a population-sized result without using private raw participant material.
- Exact provider and StoryAtlas SHAs, runtime/browser versions, warmup policy, hardware, sample sizes, and measurement method accompany results.
- Semantic parity and receipt/provenance retention are checked before comparing performance; no faster proxy may replace the estimand or hide missing data.
- Threshold breaches fail visibly and yield bounded follow-up work; renderer expansion is justified only by an observed, reproducible bottleneck.
- Browser runs include keyboard paths, 200 percent zoom, reduced motion, non-colour semantics, and resource/network assertions.
- Claims are limited to the measured configurations; hosted CI or publication is not inferred from local measurements.

2026-09-22 WORKSPACE DESIGN CATALOG
Governing implementation design: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md; granular crosswalk is section 10.3. Live Mote owns status. Existing scientific/static acceptance remains in force.
Bounded child work (reuse these tickets rather than reimplementing inside this parent):
- bd-01M35A7D5DH1AB8XYWH00DFFHE — [Scale] Add full-inventory navigator and readable matrix range controls
- bd-01M35A7DCJMR1CR3QSXZCK51VY — [Scale] Measure and implement bounded sparse rendering without identity loss
- bd-01M35A7DJX9CXQ84FKBFV401G5 — [Scale] Qualify whole-recall performance and resolution fallbacks
- bd-01M35A7FPSKEQ8V3AC2H8C30Q4 — [Compare] Switch and compare compatible recalls on a fixed source axis
This issue retains integrated acceptance/original broader scope. Its new local dependency chain covers child delivery; child closure alone is not proof of the parent acceptance. Do not add a child dependency back to this parent.
Single-recall overview/rendering/scale children can execute after the matrix without waiting for this broad parent or substantial-text/cohort certification. Complete inventory differs from individually visible rows. Numeric aggregation requires a provider packet; neutral range navigation is the baseline. Four-screen completion consumes bd-01M35A7DJX9CXQ84FKBFV401G5, not closure of this broader population ticket.
